joaosbreeze by codexdimpudim · Based on Breeze by x8rr · Source · AGPL-3.0

These links share the same site and backend. A new address does not fix sign-in or game compatibility.

what’s new

1.1 · October 28 2026

  • Interactive CDN edition with a separate HTML backup.
  • Favorites and recent links, saved on this browser.
  • Jump back into your last opened link.
  • Shuffle, search full filenames, and choose a color theme.
  • Keyboard shortcuts: / to search and Escape to clear or close.
  • Copy buttons now report success only when copying succeeds.

1.0 · original link directory

50 links, search, copy, random opening, a live clock, and the original Outfit styling.

potential next features

Ideas only — these are not released yet.

  • Named collections for different link groups.
  • Import and export of your saved favorites.
  • Optional link availability checks.

Favorites and history stay in this browser’s storage. Nothing here creates a browsing-history database. External fonts and destination sites still make their own requests.
